import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json, math, os
ROOT='/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60'
OUTER_OFFSET=0.20
CAVITY_CLEARANCE=0.05
BOTTOM_HEIGHT=0.80
FLOOR_REMAIN=0.25
TOP_Z=1.07
TOP_THICKNESS=0.35
TRACKBALL_CENTER=(16.0995,-11.4535)
TRACKBALL_RADIUS=1.85
TRACKBALL_LIP_RADIUS=2.10
def p(x,y): return adsk.core.Point3D.create(x,y,0)
def pcb_pt(x,y): return p(x/10.0,-y/10.0)
def orient_pt(cx,cy,u,n,a,b):
    return p(cx+u[0]*a+n[0]*b, cy+u[1]*a+n[1]*b)
def oriented_rect(sk,cx,cy,u,n,w,h):
    ls=sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines
    q=[orient_pt(cx,cy,u,n,-w/2,-h/2),orient_pt(cx,cy,u,n,w/2,-h/2),orient_pt(cx,cy,u,n,w/2,h/2),orient_pt(cx,cy,u,n,-w/2,h/2)]
    for i in range(4): ls.addByTwoPoints(q[i],q[(i+1)%4])
def circle(sk,cx,cy,r):
    sk.sketchCurves.sketchCircles.addByCenterRadius(p(cx,cy),r)
def make_ring_sketch(root,name,ring,plane):
    sk=root.sketches.add(plane); sk.name=name
    ls=sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines
    for a,b in zip(ring,ring[1:]):
        ls.addByTwoPoints(p(a[0]/10.0,-a[1]/10.0),p(b[0]/10.0,-b[1]/10.0))
    return sk
def make_offset_sketch(root,name,ring,plane,offset):
    src=make_ring_sketch(root,name+'_SOURCE',ring,plane)
    prof=src.profiles.item(0); bb=prof.boundingBox
    oc=adsk.core.ObjectCollection.create(); loop=prof.profileLoops.item(0)
    for i in range(loop.profileCurves.count): oc.add(loop.profileCurves.item(i).sketchEntity)
    outside=adsk.core.Point3D.create(bb.minPoint.x-1,bb.minPoint.y-1,0)
    result=src.offset(oc,outside,offset)
    if not result or result.count<1: raise RuntimeError('offset failed: '+name)
    dst=root.sketches.add(plane); dst.name=name
    projected=dst.project2([e for e in result],False)
    if not projected or len(projected)<1: raise RuntimeError('projection failed: '+name)
    src.isVisible=False; dst.isVisible=False
    if dst.profiles.count<1: raise RuntimeError('no profile: '+name)
    return dst
def ext_new(root,sk,dist,name):
    f=root.features.extrudeFeatures.addSimple(sk.profiles.item(0),adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(dist),adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.NewBodyFeatureOperation)
    f.name=name
    return root.bRepBodies.item(root.bRepBodies.count-1)
def cut_body(root,sk,dist,body,name):
    ex=root.features.extrudeFeatures; inp=ex.createInput(sk.profiles.item(0),adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.CutFeatureOperation)
    inp.setDistanceExtent(False,adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(dist)); inp.participantBodies=[body]
    f=ex.add(inp); f.name=name; return f
def ring_sketch(root,name,plane,cx,cy,r_outer,r_inner):
    sk=root.sketches.add(plane); sk.name=name
    circle(sk,cx,cy,r_outer); circle(sk,cx,cy,r_inner); sk.isVisible=False
    return sk
def make_case(side,ring_path,interface_path,base_name):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc=app.documents.add(adsk.core.DocumentTypes.FusionDesignDocumentType,True)
    des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType')); root=des.rootComponent
    data=json.load(open(ring_path)); ring=data['rings_pcb_mm'][0]
    iface=json.load(open(interface_path)); supports=iface['supports'][side]
    base=os.path.join(ROOT,'mechanical/gasket_v1')
    xy=root.xYConstructionPlane
    outer=make_offset_sketch(root,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_OUTER',ring,xy,OUTER_OFFSET)
    body=ext_new(root,outer,BOTTOM_HEIGHT,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_CASE_BOTTOM')
    body.name=side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_CASE_BOTTOM'
    cavity=make_offset_sketch(root,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_CAVITY',ring,xy,CAVITY_CLEARANCE)
    cut_body(root,cavity,BOTTOM_HEIGHT-FLOOR_REMAIN,body,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_CAVITY_CUT')
    for entry in supports:
        center=entry['pad_center_cad_mm']; tb=entry['tangent_pcb']; nb=entry['outward_normal_pcb']
        u=(tb[0],-tb[1]); n=(nb[0],-nb[1])
        sk=root.sketches.add(xy); sk.name=side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_GASKET_'+entry['id']
        oriented_rect(sk,center[0]/10.0,center[1]/10.0,u,n,entry['pad_size_mm'][0]/10.0,entry['pad_size_mm'][1]/10.0)
        ext_new(root,sk,BOTTOM_HEIGHT,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_GASKET_PAD_'+entry['id']); sk.isVisible=False
    if side=='right':
        cx,cy=TRACKBALL_CENTER
        hs=root.sketches.add(xy); hs.name='RIGHT_CONTOUR_TRACKBALL_CUT'; circle(hs,cx,cy,TRACKBALL_RADIUS); cut_body(root,hs,BOTTOM_HEIGHT,body,'RIGHT_CONTOUR_TRACKBALL_CUT'); hs.isVisible=False
        lip=ring_sketch(root,'RIGHT_CONTOUR_TRACKBALL_LIP',xy,cx,cy,TRACKBALL_LIP_RADIUS,TRACKBALL_RADIUS)
        ext_new(root,lip,0.20,'RIGHT_CONTOUR_TRACKBALL_LIP')
    for sk in root.sketches: sk.isVisible=False
    mgr=des.exportManager
    bottom_stl=os.path.join(base,base_name+'_bottom.stl')
    bottom_step=os.path.join(base,base_name+'_bottom.step')
    ok_bottom_stl=mgr.execute(mgr.createSTLExportOptions(root,bottom_stl))
    ok_bottom_step=mgr.execute(mgr.createSTEPExportOptions(bottom_step,root))
    pi=root.constructionPlanes.createInput(); pi.setByOffset(xy,adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(TOP_Z)); plane=root.constructionPlanes.add(pi)
    top_outer=make_offset_sketch(root,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_TOP_OUTER',ring,plane,OUTER_OFFSET)
    top=ext_new(root,top_outer,TOP_THICKNESS,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_CASE_TOP'); top.name=side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_CASE_TOP'
    top_cavity=make_offset_sketch(root,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_TOP_CAVITY',ring,plane,CAVITY_CLEARANCE)
    cut_body(root,top_cavity,TOP_THICKNESS,top,side.upper()+'_CONTOUR_TOP_CAVITY_CUT')
    if side=='right':
        hs2=root.sketches.add(plane); hs2.name='RIGHT_CONTOUR_TOP_TRACKBALL_CUT'; circle(hs2,TRACKBALL_CENTER[0],TRACKBALL_CENTER[1],TRACKBALL_RADIUS); cut_body(root,hs2,TOP_THICKNESS,top,'RIGHT_CONTOUR_TOP_TRACKBALL_CUT'); hs2.isVisible=False
    for sk in root.sketches: sk.isVisible=False
    top_stl=os.path.join(base,base_name+'_top.stl')
    complete_step=os.path.join(base,base_name+'_complete.step')
    ok_top_stl=mgr.execute(mgr.createSTLExportOptions(top,top_stl))
    ok_complete=mgr.execute(mgr.createSTEPExportOptions(complete_step,root))
    app.activeViewport.fit()
    shot=os.path.join('/tmp',base_name+'_complete.png'); ok_shot=app.activeViewport.saveAsImageFile(shot,1600,1000)
    return {'side':side,'document':doc.name,'bodies':[b.name for b in root.bRepBodies],'outerOffsetMm':OUTER_OFFSET*10,'cavityClearanceMm':CAVITY_CLEARANCE*10,'bottomStl':bool(ok_bottom_stl),'bottomStep':bool(ok_bottom_step),'topStl':bool(ok_top_stl),'completeStep':bool(ok_complete),'screenshot':shot,'screenshotSaved':bool(ok_shot)}
def run(_context):
    out=[]
    out.append(make_case('left',os.path.join(ROOT,'pcb/mx_plate/gasket_v1/mx_plate_gasket_geometry.json'),os.path.join(ROOT,'mechanical/gasket_v1/case_interface.json'),'sage60_left_case_contour'))
    out.append(make_case('right',os.path.join(ROOT,'pcb/mx_plate_right_tb/gasket_v1/mx_plate_right_tb_gasket_geometry.json'),os.path.join(ROOT,'mechanical/gasket_v1/case_interface.json'),'sage60_right_tb_case_contour'))
    print(json.dumps(out))
